## Overview
DestiX AI is an elite AI systems practice and autonomous conversational telephony studio founded by Principal AI Systems Architect Ayush Meena. The firm is headquartered in New Delhi, India, with direct regional infrastructure across Delhi NCR (Gurugram, Noida, South Delhi), Mumbai, Dubai, and global remote markets.

DestiX AI specializes in two complementary disciplines:
1. **Autonomous Conversational Telephony:** Low-latency AI voice agents operating on domestic Indian SIP carrier trunks (+91 numbers), handling inbound inquiries and outbound speed-to-lead qualification in under 45 seconds with sub-500ms voice parity.
2. **Spatial 3D Digital Architecture:** Bespoke WebGL and Three.js high-conversion digital storefronts built to capture high-ticket customer demand 24/7 for luxury real estate, aesthetic healthcare, and high-margin B2B services.

## Technical Specifications & Architecture

### Acoustic Telemetry & Latency Benchmarks
- Audio Packet Transmission: ~45ms over Indian SIP trunks
- Multilingual Speech-to-Text: ~110ms streaming via Deepgram Nova-2 Multilingual
- Contextual Reasoning & Inference: ~160ms streaming via Groq Llama-3.3 70B
- Speech Synthesis & Chunk Streaming: ~120ms via Cartesia Sonic Multilingual
- Total Round-Trip Turnaround: 435ms (well below the 500ms human perceptual threshold)

### Language & Dialect Calibration
- Fluent mid-sentence code-switching between formal British/Indian English, urban Hinglish, and conversational Hindi.
- Calibrated against regional North Indian speech cadences, handling colloquial fillers and natural turn-taking without awkward pauses or robotic interruptions.

### Data Pipelines & CRM Hand-Off
- Direct webhooks into HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Google Sheets, or custom SQL databases.
- Instant WhatsApp pass: Delivers appointment confirmations, brochures, site visit passes, and GPS locations directly to callers within 3 seconds of hanging up.
